connectionParameters.label: Pwned Passwords Base URL
connectionParameters.name: passwords_base_url
connectionParameters.desc: Pwned Passwords range API base URL (e.g. https://api.pwnedpasswords.com)

connectionParameters.label: API Key
connectionParameters.name: api_key
connectionParameters.desc: Have I Been Pwned API key (sent in the hibp-api-key header) for account, paste, domain and stealer-log endpoints.

connectionParameters.label: User Agent
connectionParameters.name: user_agent
connectionParameters.desc: User-agent sent on every request identifying the API consumer (required by HIBP; a missing user-agent returns HTTP 403).

desc: Have I Been Pwned (HIBP) API v3 integration for checking whether accounts, domains, and passwords have appeared in known data breaches, pastes, and stealer logs. Supports breach/paste lookups, k-anonymity range searches, domain breach exposure, and breach catalogue enrichment. Data is provided by Have I Been Pwned (https://haveibeenpwned.com) under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

functions.label: Check Breached Account
functions.name: check_breached_account
functions.desc: Return all breaches an account (email, username, or phone) has appeared in. Requires an API key.

inParameters.label: Account
inParameters.name: account
inParameters.desc: The account to search for (email, username, or phone). URL-encoded and case-insensitive.

inParameters.label: Truncate Response
inParameters.name: truncate_response
inParameters.desc: Return only breach names when true (default), or full breach objects when false.

inParameters.label: Domain
inParameters.name: domain
inParameters.desc: Filter results to breaches against this domain only (e.g. adobe.com).

inParameters.label: Include Unverified
inParameters.name: include_unverified
inParameters.desc: Include breaches flagged as unverified (default: true).

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: Breach results for the account with total count and breached flag.

functions.label: Check Breached Domain
functions.name: check_breached_domain
functions.desc: Return all breached email aliases on a verified domain and the breaches they appeared in. Requires an API key and a verified domain.

inParameters.label: Domain
inParameters.name: domain
inParameters.desc: Verified domain to search (must be added to the domain search dashboard).

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: Mapping of email aliases to breach names, with total count.

functions.label: Check Paste Account
functions.name: check_paste_account
functions.desc: Return all pastes an email address has appeared in, newest first. Requires an API key.

inParameters.label: Account
inParameters.name: account
inParameters.desc: The email address to search for. URL-encoded and case-insensitive.

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: Paste records for the account with total count.

functions.label: Check Stealer Logs By Email
functions.name: check_stealer_logs_by_email
functions.desc: Return the website domains where an email appeared in stealer logs. Requires a Pro API key and a verified domain.

inParameters.label: Email
inParameters.name: email
inParameters.desc: The email address (on a verified domain) to search for.

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of website domains from stealer logs with total count.

functions.label: Check Password Range
functions.name: check_password_range
functions.desc: Query the Pwned Passwords range API using k-anonymity (first 5 hash characters). No API key required.

inParameters.label: Hash Prefix
inParameters.name: hash_prefix
inParameters.desc: First 5 hexadecimal characters of the SHA-1 or NTLM password hash.

inParameters.label: Add Padding
inParameters.name: add_padding
inParameters.desc: Request padded responses (padding rows with count 0 are discarded automatically).

inParameters.label: Mode
inParameters.name: mode
inParameters.desc: Hash mode; set to 'ntlm' for NTLM suffixes. Defaults to SHA-1.

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of hash suffixes and their prevalence counts.

functions.label: Check Breached Account Range
functions.name: check_breached_account_range
functions.desc: Search breaches for an email by SHA-1 hash range using k-anonymity (first 6 hash characters). Requires a Pro/High RPM API key.

inParameters.label: Hash Prefix
inParameters.name: hash_prefix
inParameters.desc: First 6 hexadecimal characters of the normalized email address SHA-1 hash.

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of objects containing hashSuffix and the breach names (websites) it appeared in.

functions.label: Get Latest Breach
functions.name: get_latest_breach
functions.desc: Return the most recently added breach based on AddedDate. No API key required.

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: The most recently added breach object.

functions.label: Get Breaches
functions.name: get_breaches
functions.desc: Return the breach catalogue, optionally filtered by domain or spam-list flag. No API key required.

inParameters.label: Domain
inParameters.name: domain
inParameters.desc: Filter the catalogue to breaches against this domain (e.g. adobe.com).

inParameters.label: Is Spam List
inParameters.name: is_spam_list
inParameters.desc: Filter to breaches that are (true) or are not (false) flagged as a spam list.

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: List of breach objects in the catalogue with total count.

functions.label: Get Data Classes
functions.name: get_data_classes
functions.desc: Return all data classes (compromised attribute types) in the system. No API key required.

outParameters.label: Results
outParameters.name: results
outParameters.desc: Alphabetically ordered list of data class names with total count.
